=== service unit ===
# /etc/systemd/system/clore-hosting.service
[Unit]
Description=CLORE.AI hosting agent
Wants=network-online.target docker.service
After=network-online.target docker.service
ConditionPathExists=/opt/clore-hosting/client/auth

[Service]
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/opt/clore-hosting/hosting
ExecStart=/opt/clore-hosting/.venv/bin/python -u hosting.py --service
Restart=always
RestartSec=10
TimeoutStopSec=30
KillMode=mixed

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
